mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_knowledge_base (user_id, name, description, icon, is_public) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_knowledge_base WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, document_count = #{documentCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
